author: Tashner family
title: John Charles Tashner Jr. — confirmed family history and service record: a family research dossier
notes:
A dossier compiled by the family in August 2026 around the service-record transcription: identity, dates, a chronology restating the record, historical context, and research leads. Where it restates the record, this project cites the record (source:tashner-service-record) and not the restatement; this entry exists for the few facts the record does not carry. Those are: that Jay Tashner died in September 1977; that his wife was Margaret Monroe Holston Tashner; and that a 1943 San Diego city directory lists "Tashner John C (Margt) USN" at 3724 Van Dyke Avenue — a citation to a directory nobody on this project has opened. The death and the marriage are family knowledge relayed by the family, which is what the testimony rung holds; the directory line is a pointer to a primary source and is cited as a pointer.

Two of its working rules are adopted here because they are this project's own rules arrived at independently. Its scope note says it does not treat AI-generated colorization detail as evidence, and it warns in terms that ribbon colours in a colorized portrait "should not be used as historical evidence" — the documented award list is the authority. The portrait manifest under content/shared/media/people/tashner-john-charles-jr/ carries that warning forward. And its closing section insists that unit-level events must not be attributed personally to the man unless his own record or another primary source connects him to them, which is ADR 0005's discipline in the family's hand.

Its research leads are filed as leads and not as facts: it connects USS Ballard's Midway rescue with the carrier Hiryū ("historical research connects..."), which the service record itself never names, and it flags ComPatWing TWO, Ballard's June 1942 war diary, CASU-16 and CASU-30 unit records as archival follow-ups. Those threads are recorded on the source entry for the record, pointed at the Midway and Tarawa packs.
